messages:
lynn: Orson Labs reached out with a "preview access" ask. They want a lightweight marketplace entry + a quick compatibility run in their edge rack next week. NDA attached.

josh: can you paste the NDA? i'll coordinate infra and plan the run. curious what hw we're dealing with.

lynn: NDA: https://orm.internal/orson/nda-redwood-v1.pdf. Partner-ops says it's an Orson EdgeBox (4xT4-equivalent) with custom drivers. they want us to run a 512-token summarization, batch embeddings (batch=64), and an L1 latency spike test.

tara: short checklist from eng: 1) confirm driver compatibility, 2) build kernels with orson-driver shim, 3) ensure our KV cache fits in 20GB. we should also test cold-start latency.

felix: FYI from infra: Orson requires images signed with our reg cert and uses a restricted egress network. we'll need to push staging image to partner registry and ensure our agent doesn't phone home.

marta: legal-bot flagged telemetry clause. they want unrestricted metrics access; we'll need to push back. setting up a redline request.

legal-bot: Proposed redline uploaded: https://legal.internal/redlines/orson-nda-redwood.json. Key change: telemetry limited to aggregate metrics only; block any raw request/response transfer.

josh: infra plan snippet:
```bash
# push signed image to partner registry
skopeo copy docker://redwood/orson-preview:staging \
  docker://partner-registry.orson.net/redwood/orson-preview:staging --sign
```

josh: i'll also mount /dev/nvshim and add orson-driver v0.4 to the kernel set. staging tag: orson-staging-1760.

felix: for benchmarks, propose metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput (reqs/s), GPU mem high-water, CPU steal, cold-start ms. also capture temp and fan RPMs for thermals.

tara: good list. add success-rate and model-output checksum to detect corruption. keep raw outputs hashed.

lynn: partner-ops: can Orson provide a VLAN for us to push telemetry to their bucket? we prefer partner-only for preview.

partner-ops: yes, we'll get a partner-only bucket and short-lived creds. Orson asked that telemetry be togglable via env var ORS_TELEMETRY=partner|off.

marta: legal-bot recommends default=off until NDA signed. after NDA, default=partner. also require that any redwood-only telemetry be explicitly opt-in.

josh: timeline proposal: NDA signed by Mon EOD -> infra image push Tue morning -> first perf run Tue afternoon -> QA + sign-off Wed -> marketplace draft Thurs. doable?

lynn: sounds realistic. I'm asking Orson for NDA signature today.

felix: small technical note: Orson's firmware may throttle sustained throughput. we'll run a 10-minute soak and a 2-minute burst to capture behavior. please include a 1-hour cooldown between runs.

tara: I'll write the harness config. naming: orson-preview.yaml. key fields: concurrency=4, batch_size=64 (embed), token_limit=512 (summ).

josh: putting skeleton harness here: https://internal.redwood/harnesses/orson-preview. will update with run IDs. use --capture-aggregates-only flag.

marta: also drafting the marketplace blurb: "Orson EdgeBox preview: limited early access to Orson-accelerated inference. NDA required; lab-only performance metrics. Contact partnerships@redwood.ai." Legal will vet.

partner-ops: Orson requests that the listing call out "edge-optimized" variant and include a short note about region constraints.

felix: small blocker: our logging pipeline currently sends debug traces. must remove before any runs on partner network. josh, can you add a preflight to strip traces?

josh: yep. will add preflight hook to fail if TRACE_LEVEL>info. also will swap S3 uploads to partner-bucket via signed creds.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-9001: Orson Edge preview - NDA / signed image / benchmark runs. Assignee: lynn. Due: 1760090000. :white_check_mark:

lynn: thanks. volunteers to produce the one-page benchmark summary we hand to Orson? i'll draft but need someone to verify numbers.

tara: i'll own the harness and config.

felix: i'll validate numbers and check thermal logs.

marta: legal-bot will sign off on telemetry wording once redline accepted.

lynn: excellent. will update here when NDA is in. once we have signed NDA i'll paste the final run schedule. :rocket:
